192. An Incident Three Days Ago (1)
Three days ago, at the Tower of Stories.
That day, the leadership of Jipil was also engaged in a meeting, busily monitoring the movements of Run-Candel and Kinselo. However, the atmosphere in the meeting room was unusually tense.
It was because Veradin had excluded Kadun from the meeting.
"...Lord, are you really not going to call Lord Kadun?" Octavia said.
"My Lord, why don't you call Lord Kadun now? Lord Kadun will be very disappointed."
Even Ronil, who had never opposed Veradin's decisions, thought this time it was too harsh.
In the era when Kelliac was healthy, Kadun was the guardian dragon of the entire Jipil, a being with a higher rank than either Octavia or Andreina.
It was not that Kadun had committed a mistake so grave as to warrant being excluded from the leadership meeting.

Surprisingly, after being humiliated by Veradin in the previous meeting, Kadun hadn't shown any anger in the meeting room ever since. Even when uncomfortable conversations due to Run-Candel occurred, he managed to keep his temper under control and remain silent.
"Is there a problem in progressing the meeting without Lord Kadun?"
Veradin had no intention of responding to the leaders' requests.
"My Lord, that's not the point... why do you keep provoking Lord Kadun?"

"I didn't call him because I didn't want to see him sitting around with a sullen face at every meeting. The one who's being provocative is not me, but Lord Kadun. Does it not matter if Lord Kadun shows discomfort in front of me?"

"My Lord! This 1st floor, the Tower of Stories, is originally the domain of the Lord and Lord Kadun. If you exclude him from the meetings here for such a petty reason, how do you think Lord Kadun would feel?"
"We need to keep an eye on our enemies now, not the time to care about personal feelings."
"Unity is important, you said it yourself, my Lord! While the enemies are united under Jin Run-Candel and Orgal, we at Jipil are fighting like this. Do you have any hard feelings against Lord Kadun?"
"Fine, then let's move the meeting room right now. Shall we proceed in Draka, not the Tower of Stories?"

"To the end......! If you keep going like this, I'll find it hard to trust your judgement, my Lord. Not just in meetings, but in all important matters. If there is no convincing reason to exclude Lord Kadun."
"No reason?"
When Veradin asked with cold eyes, Octavia stopped talking.

"If it were not me, but my father who did this, could you have acted as you are now? Ghost Captain. What will you do if there's no reason? Are you going to rebel? Or are you not going to attend the meeting with Lord Kadun. That too can be seen as rebellion since it disobeys my command."
"What, rebellion...!"

"The lord's command is absolute. Even the ancient ghosts who were the former lords under Run-Candel obeyed the law well. If you act like this because my ability seems to be inferior to Jin, I have nothing to say, but I think many people in our family are not sane right now."
Octavia clenched her teeth and avoided Veradin's gaze.
'Why on earth did that kid change like this...!'
When Veradin, who had lost all memory and was in a newborn state, first regained consciousness, it was an extremely joyous event for Jipil.

Moreover, the returned Veradin quickly took control of the family and even gained a power similar to record magic. Thanks to this, they could end the demonic war without much damage, and somewhat fill the void left by Kelliac.
However, in Octavia's view, Veradin lately was going mad.

'Is this a side effect of the mental manipulation we carried out? No, more than side effects... it feels like revenge for mental manipulation. Lord Kadun is the one most deeply involved in that child's mental manipulation.'
At that thought, suddenly another name crossed Octavia's mind. The name of the person who led Veradin's mental manipulation deeper than Kadun.
'The Lord...! If Veradin is retaliating against Lord Kadun in madness, he could reach out to the Lord as well!'
Kelliac Jipil.
He has been unable to escape from the maintenance device on the top floor of the Tower of Stories for several years now.
And only two people in Jipil could freely enter and exit the top floor of the Tower of Stories. Fire Dragon Kadun and Veradin Jipil.
If Veradin were to attack Kelliac's maintenance device alone...
Naturally, Kelliac now would not be able to retaliate.
The thought of this spectacle sent chills down Octavia's entire body. It was something she had never thought of until Veradin became aggressive.
'If what that child is doing is really revenge, and if he has no intention of stopping.'
They had to depose Veradin now. No matter how dangerous and turbulent the situation is, the possibility of Veradin 'killing' Kelliac must be eliminated.
"Ghost Captain, you're one of those people too. Daring to speak so loudly just because you're uncomfortable with my treatment of Lord Kadun. It seems that you see me as quite laughable."
"...I will be careful from now on, My Lord. I showed a lacking side."
"I hope you're sincere. I hope you won't make a mistake with a different heart."
Octavia shivered at the sensation of Veradin seemingly seeing right through her. It occurred to her that Veradin might have become so strong that neither she nor Kadun could suppress him.

"Now, let's start the meeting. We need to find a way to cut off the warriors and engineers gathering at Run-Candel. Ever since the existence of Valeria Hester became known to the public, too many talents are flowing into Run-Candel."
"Almost all the people who have applied from within the federation have been investigated. There were more than 2,000 wizards and engineers, how should we deal with them?"
"Ronil brother and Ghost Captain, please give your opinions."
"I think we should kill a few as examples, and absorb the rest."

"I'd prefer to kill them all. After all, the real talents among those 2,000 have already switched to the alliance, so the rest are essentially meaningless forces. It's better to kill them and instill fear in others."

"Both aren't bad choices. But given the current situation, I will postpone the punishment of those suspected of treason. Bring all those who couldn't go to the Bamel Union to our laboratory. Even if it's simple chores, let's use them until the situation stabilizes and then reconsider their disposition."
"We will proceed that way."
"And then..."
Just as he was about to discuss the next agenda, Veradin's eyes suddenly sharpened.
At the same time, Ronil and Octavia were also shocked and heightened their senses. This was because they felt a very familiar, enormous and fierce energy quickly approaching the Tower of Stories.
"It seems Lord Kadun is about to cross the line..."
It was Kadun's energy. If he was just flying, his energy wouldn't be this rough. Clear hostility and anger were already coloring the entire sky outside.
"Brother Ronil."
"Yes, My Lord."
"Order the entire force on standby in the tower to immediately adopt a war posture."
My Lord!
Octavia was about to shout out but just managed to keep her mouth shut.
'Lord Kadun, why now of all times...!'
She couldn't have anticipated that Kadun would come looking for the Tower of Stories with the intention to kill Veradin.
Octavia knows Kadun well.
In fact, it was nearly miraculous that he had endured all kinds of insults from Veradin so far. The Kadun she knew would have settled the score with Veradin a long time ago.
'First of all, I must stop Lord Kadun in any way. It's absolutely wrong for Lord Kadun and Veradin to fight right now!'
She could somehow stop Kadun. If she earnestly appealed that not fighting now is in the best interest for Jiple, Kadun would eventually stop.
The real problem, however, was Veradin. Octavia wondered if Veradin could really overlook Kadun who was showing his teeth. It didn't seem likely.
'If Veradin decides to abandon Lord Kadun and launches a preemptive attack, what should I do...!'
It's impossible to know who will win that fight. What's important is that, no matter who wins, Jiple will suffer irreversible damage.
As she stepped outside, she could see Kadun descending through the clouds.
The wizards in the tower were already in battle readiness, pointing their staffs at Kadun. Veradin stood among them, glaring at Kadun.
"Veradin...! You, why are you doing this to me. Can you really think this is okay, towards me, the pillar of the family and the guardian dragon of your father!"
"This is your last warning, Lord Kadun. Immediately withdraw your energy and accept the family's subjugation. What you're doing right now is rebellion."

"Rebellion! This bloody fool finally lost his mind. Wizards who point their staffs at me, I'll give you a chance. Who will you follow? That mad lord has no future anymore. Today, I will turn him into a pile of ashes."
"Ah, so it comes to this. Fine. From now on, the Fire Dragon Kadun is a class 1 traitor of the family. Wizards of the tower, protect me."
"My lord, just a moment. Give me a chance to talk to Lord Kadun. I'll try to stop him! I stake my name and honor on it, absolutely."
"There's no need, Ghost Captain. What do you think is the reason I'm treating Lord Kadun so harshly?"
"Please, do tell us. Why are you doing this? Even Lord Kadun doesn't know."
Octavia pleaded almost like begging. She had to prevent the family from splitting in two.
At that, Veradin turned around and pointed to the top of the tower.
"From now on, keep a close eye on where our father is up there. See what's happening."
With that, Veradin stretched out the Lord's staff, 'Huroti', towards Kadun.
